page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.16xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per physical core. Each core runs a single thread, ensuring dedicated compute allocation without hyperthreading.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for data persistence. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps to support data-intensive operations. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a dense memory footprint makes it suitable for workloads requiring predictable compute performance and large memory capacities, avoiding the resource contention associated with shared-core or hyperthreaded environments.

Given its hardware profile, the ecs.r7.16xlarge is designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. Appropriate use cases include large-scale in-memory databases, caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-bound data processing or analytics pipelines that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
